yonga.config.reiniciar: Restart the game to apply the changes
yonga.modulo.armas.desc: Lucarita weapons (falcata, halberd, gladius, mace, dagger, knightly sword, rapier) and the parry mechanic.
yonga.modulo.sangrado.desc: Bleeding effect, bandages and the Cortante enchantment. If disabled, weapons don't cause bleeding.
yonga.modulo.fe.desc: Faith system: points, levels, ranks and mana for each player, praying and blaspheming, faith orbs from mobs, HUD bars, inventory menu and /fe command.
yonga.fe.oracion.no_puedes: You need to stand still on the ground
yonga.modulo.roles.desc: Player professions (Herrero, Explorador, Sacerdote, Ingeniero, Melómano) with ranks from Novato to Maestro.
yonga.rol.menu.sin_rol: You don't have a profession yet.
yonga.rol.menu.aviso: You can change it later, but you'll start from scratch.
yonga.rol.confirmar.mensaje: You'll stop being %s and lose your %s rank. You'll start as Novato in the new profession.
yonga.rol.elegido: You are now %s. You start as Novato!
yonga.rol.herrero.desc: Everything worth having is forged blow by blow.
yonga.rol.explorador.desc: No horizon is too far for him.
yonga.rol.sacerdote.desc: His faith weighs more than anyone's.
yonga.rol.ingeniero.desc: What others dream of, he builds.
yonga.rol.fantasma.desc: He passes through the world without a trace.
yonga.flauta.domado: %s is your companion! It will follow you
yonga.flauta.demasiado_fuerte: %s is too strong for your flute (max %s health)
yonga.flauta.ya_tienes: You already have a companion. Only one at a time
yonga.fe.comando.astado_acecho: The Antlered One's stalking begins (it ends unless it is night and you are in a forest)
yonga.fe.comando.astado_aparece: The Antlered One has appeared behind you
yonga.fe.comando.astado_sin_sitio: There is nowhere nearby for the Antlered One to appear
subtitles.yonga.centinela_rayo: Sentinel fires a beam of light
subtitles.yonga.zor_muerte: Zor the Burnt crumbles to ash
yonga.ritual.sin_espacio: It can't be summoned here: it needs more space
yonga.modulo.tabaco.desc: Tobacco plant, cigarettes, cigars and the cigarette pack. Light them with flint and steel; each puff usually gives a boost (with +1.5 reach), but sometimes wither and nausea (likelier the more you smoke).
yonga.sagrado.tunica: Neither light nor shadow gets through.
yonga.sagrado.cuernos: What the light fears, you wear on your brow.
yonga.garfio.uso: Where the rope reaches, so do you.
item.yonga.disco_pitito_con_el_cierre.de: Me Agarré el Pitito Con el Cierre
item.yonga.disco_drunken_sailor.desc: What Shall We Do with the Drunken Sailor
yonga.modulo.habitantes.desc: People who replace villagers: each with their own era, age, body and life. They grow up in real days.
yonga.frase.neutral.0: What can I do for you?
yonga.frase.amable.0: How good to see you here!
yonga.frase.amable.3: If you need anything, just say so.
yonga.frase.hostil.1: I've nothing to say to you.
yonga.frase.enfadado.0: I don't want to talk to you.
yonga.frase.nino.1: My mum says not to talk to strangers!
yonga.trato.contra: I'll let you have %s, and that's that.
yonga.trato.todo: I'll take %s %% off everything until tomorrow.
yonga.habla.perdido: %s fell behind and stopped following you.
yonga.charla.plaza.0: Have you seen the weather today?
yonga.charla.plaza.1: They say there were noises in the forest last night.
yonga.charla.plaza.2: My cousin came from the other valley yesterday.
yonga.charla.plaza.5: The harvest looks good this year.
yonga.charla.oficio.0: I've had a lot of work today.
yonga.charla.oficio.1: I've hardly anything left to sell.
yonga.charla.oficio.2: A stranger bought everything I had.
yonga.charla.oficio.3: Early start tomorrow, lots to do.
yonga.charla.oficio.4: Tools aren't what they used to be.
yonga.charla.paro.0: Know anyone who needs a hand?
yonga.charla.paro.1: If I find a good workshop, I'll start tomorrow.
yonga.charla.paro.2: I helped unload a cart yesterday and got some bread for it.
yonga.charla.paro.3: I wish someone would build another oven in the village.
yonga.charla.holgazan.4: If anyone's looking for me, I'm resting.
yonga.charla.trabajo.1: This workstation is free... it's mine!
yonga.charla.trabajo.2: No more wandering: time to work.
yonga.amor.declara.1: Want to go for a walk with me tonight?
yonga.amor.declara.2: I can't stop thinking about you, you know?
yonga.amor.boda: We're getting married! Long live love!
yonga.amor.embarazo: We're going to have a baby!
yonga.amor.adopta: From today, this little one is part of our family.
yonga.amor.celos.0: How could you? They told me everything!
yonga.amor.celos.1: So you're seeing someone else... Shameful!
yonga.amor.celos.2: The whole village knows but me, right?
yonga.amor.deja: It's over. I never want to see you again.
yonga.amor.novios: You and %s are now a couple.
yonga.amor.sin_huerfanos: There are no children without a family in the village.
yonga.amor.nace.hijo: Your son has been born. His name is %s.
yonga.amor.nace.hija: Your daughter has been born. Her name is %s.
yonga.amor.sexo.hombre: Villagers will see you as a man.
yonga.amor.sexo.mujer: Villagers will see you as a woman.
yonga.sexo.explica: Villagers will treat you accordingly. You can change it with /yonga sexo.
yonga.libro.solo_creativo: The Creator's Book only works in creative mode.
yonga.regalo.rol: Role items can't be given away.
yonga.amor.r.ya_pareja.1: I'm already yours. Did you forget?
yonga.amor.r.familia.1: I love you, but as family.
yonga.amor.r.desactivado.0: I don't know what you mean.
yonga.amor.r.pareja.0: I'm sorry... I already have someone.
yonga.amor.r.pareja.1: I'm flattered, but my heart belongs to someone else.
yonga.amor.r.no_atrae.0: I like you, but not that way.
yonga.amor.r.no_atrae.1: Sorry, you're not my type. But we can be friends.
yonga.amor.r.ni_hablar.1: After how you've treated me? No.
yonga.amor.r.poco.0: I'm flattered... but we barely know each other.
yonga.amor.r.poco.1: Give me a little more time, okay?
yonga.amor.r.si.0: Yes! I've been waiting for you to say it.
yonga.amor.r.si.1: I feel the same way... Yes!
yonga.amor.r.deprisa.1: Excuse me? Who do you think I am?
yonga.amor.r.despacio.0: Not yet... let's take it slow.
yonga.amor.r.despacio.1: I like you, but I'm not ready yet.
yonga.amor.r.noche.1: I thought you'd never ask. Come.
yonga.amor.r.anillo_no.0: It's a beautiful ring... but I can't accept it.
yonga.amor.r.anillo_no.1: I'm sorry. I can't marry you.
yonga.amor.r.sin_salir.1: Aren't you going a bit fast?
yonga.amor.r.casado_otro.0: And your marriage? You're already married.
yonga.amor.r.casado_otro.1: I won't be anyone's second choice.
yonga.amor.r.pronto.0: It's too soon... give me time.
yonga.amor.r.pronto.1: I love you, but I'm not ready for that yet.
yonga.amor.r.boda.0: Yes, yes, a thousand times yes!
yonga.amor.r.boda.1: Of course I want to marry you!
yonga.regalo.r.4.0: Oh! I love it! How did you know?
yonga.regalo.r.4.1: It's beautiful! Thank you so much.
yonga.regalo.r.4.2: I can't believe it! It's perfect!
yonga.regalo.r.3.0: How thoughtful! I really like it.
yonga.regalo.r.3.1: Thanks, I'll put it to good use.
yonga.regalo.r.1.1: Thanks, I guess... though I don't like it.
yonga.regalo.r.1.2: Hmm. What am I supposed to do with this?
yonga.regalo.r.0.1: Get that out of my sight!
yonga.regalo.r.0.2: Are you making fun of me?
yonga.regalo.r.harto.0: You've given me plenty today, really.
yonga.regalo.r.harto.2: Thanks, but you don't have to give me so much.
yonga.amor.r.cansado.0: Not today... I'm still worn out from last time.
yonga.amor.r.cansado.1: Tomorrow, okay? I need to rest today.
yonga.amor.r.sin_cama.0: Here? No... let's find a bed.
yonga.encuentro.va_a_la_cama: They're heading to the bed. Once they lie down, right-click the bed.
yonga.encuentro.tumbate: Lie down: right-click a nearby bed.
yonga.encuentro.te_espera: They're waiting in bed: right-click it.
yonga.encuentro.espera_que_se_tumbe: Wait for them to lie down in a bed.
yonga.encuentro.cansados: It's too soon since last time.
yonga.encuentro.propone: %s wants to spend the night with you. Sneak and right-click them to accept.
yonga.encargos.sin_tabernero: The innkeeper isn't here: no quests.
yonga.encargos.sin_aldea: This board doesn't belong to any village.
yonga.encargos.aceptado: Quest accepted: kills count from now on.
yonga.encargos.otro_gano: %s beat you to it: they completed the quest (%s).
yonga.encargos.solo_tabernero: This board is empty: the innkeeper posts quests on the board in their tavern.
yonga.orden.no_sigue.1: With you? I don't know you that well.
yonga.orden.no_quieto.0: I'm not going to just stand here.
yonga.orden.no_quieto.1: I have things to do, you know?
yonga.habla.romper.titulo: Are you sure you want to break up?
yonga.habla.romper.seguro: It will hurt them, and the village will find out.
yonga.amor.r.deja_por_ti.0: Oh... I shouldn't, but... yes. I'll leave my partner for you.
yonga.amor.r.deja_por_ti.1: I've been thinking about you for a while. It's over with them: I choose you.
yonga.amor.r.infiel.0: I've heard how you treat your partners. No, thanks.
yonga.amor.r.infiel.1: So you can cheat on me like the others? No way.
yonga.amor.r.divorcio.0: After everything we've been through? I can't believe it.
yonga.amor.r.divorcio.1: You swore to love me forever... Liar.
yonga.amor.r.a_escondidas.0: Nobody has to know... Come on.
yonga.amor.r.a_escondidas.1: Shh... don't let anyone see us. Come.
yonga.amor.reproche.0: I know about you and %s. How could you?
yonga.amor.reproche.1: They told me everything: you and %s. Don't lie to me.
yonga.taberna.ya_hay: This village already has a tavern (board at %s, %s, %s).
yonga.mueble.moler.nada: Grind bones, wheat, sugar cane, cobblestone, gravel or cocoa here
yonga.mueble.coser.nada: Bring a worn piece of leather clothing to mend it
yonga.mueble.tele.3: Weather: sunny tomorrow across most of the kingdom
yonga.mueble.tele.5: A soap opera: she left him for the blacksmith
yonga.mueble.tele.7: A cooking show: rabbit stew today
